'''Logistics''' was a division of the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mai (lieutenant)|Mai]] was an officer in Logistics before being appointed to serve as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]]'s assistant.
